project.name: Gimle Ragnarok Pause
project.description: A minimal, deliberately inert Gimle module artifact -- the same shape as gimle-examples/hello-module -- built solely so gimle-ragnarok's own bundled ModuleJarSource has something to deploy without requiring gimle-examples to be built: Surtr's stress workloads only need instances to reach ACTIVE, not exercise fabric calls, so no hooks/probes are needed here either. gimle-ragnarok's own build copies this module's built jar into its own jar as a classpath resource (see gimle-ragnarok/pom.xml's maven-dependency-plugin copy execution); nothing else in the reactor depends on this module directly.
